note: Banque Populaire de Mauritanie's Bankily, a bank account the bank opens at a distance and runs from a phone (its app or USSD), served through its branches, agents and machines: its FAQ says the account is free to open and carries no account-keeping fee. Its tariff grid (fees before tax; the 2026 Finance Law adds a 20% TOF on service fees and a 0.1% TTE on payments and transfers from 5,000 MRU) prices each transfer by band of its amount: to another Bankily customer free up to 1,000 MRU, then 4.31 to 77.59 MRU; to another bank via ACH/RTGS 77.59 MRU up to 10,000, rising by band to 181.03 above 700,000. A transfer priced by band of its amount isn't a figure the account's form holds, so none is written. Cash deposits up to 300,000 MRU, balance enquiries and merchant payments are free. BPM's branch current accounts state no fee either way, and the other banks' sheets read (BAMIS's among them) name no account-keeping fee without saying keeping is free. Not stated: overdraft, a returned payment, interest, cash machines, a transfer abroad, the papers opening asks.

sources.title: Bankily (Banque Populaire de Mauritanie), FAQ
sources.said: Vous pouvez ouvrir gratuitement un compte bancaire à distance. Ce compte est gratuit et sans frais de tenue de compte. ... L’ouverture du compte Bankily est gratuite et il n’y a pas de frais de tenue de compte.
